properties.description: Creative Japanese comfort fare in a spacious, cozy setting with tall ceilings and a modern, minimalist aesthetic.
properties.short_description: Creative Japanese comfort fare in a spacious, cozy setting with tall ceilings and a modern, minimalist aesthetic.
properties.cuisine_description: Rule of Thirds serves creative Japanese comfort food and izakaya-style small plates with modern, innovative fusion touches. The menu features signature dishes like chicken katsu, souffle pancakes, and various yakitori skewers alongside a curated selection of sake, cocktails, and wine. Dietary needs are accommodated with several vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options.
properties.overall_description: Located in a renovated industrial space in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, this restaurant offers a creative and modern take on Japanese comfort food in a highly aesthetic, design-forward environment. While the food is characterized as fusion, the main draw for many visitors is the expansive, beautifully designed indoor space and the lush, tented outdoor garden area perfect for social gatherings. With a focus on craft cocktails and a strong sake selection, it serves as a versatile destination for everything from birthday brunches to trendy date nights, reflecting the vibrant and artistic energy of its surrounding neighborhood.
properties.service_description: The restaurant provides a lively and aesthetically striking setting for diverse occasions, from casual brunch and date nights to large group celebrations. It offers indoor and outdoor dining, including private pavilion rentals for events. Reservations are highly recommended for the popular space, which provides full table service and a curated beverage program.
properties.ambience_description: The ambiance is defined by a modern, minimalist aesthetic that feels both trendy and warm, with plenty of natural wood and an open-plan layout that accommodates a lively social energy.
properties.amenities_description: The venue offers versatile indoor and outdoor seating, including private pavilions for events, and is well-equipped for families, with high chairs and climate-controlled outdoor spaces available.
properties.unique_selling_points: The restaurant is distinguished by its stunning, expansive industrial design and curated outdoor 'Zen garden' courtyard, which provides a uniquely beautiful backdrop for social dining.
properties.neighborhood_description: Located in the heart of Greenpoint, the neighborhood is a bustling and creative enclave known for its lively food scene, independent shops, and artistic, industrial vibe.
properties.physical_setting_description: Set within a large, airy industrial space in Greenpoint, the restaurant features high ceilings, minimalist interiors, and a picturesque outdoor courtyard with pavilions that offer a Zen-like atmosphere.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The restaurant primarily attracts young professionals, couples, and groups of friends living in or visiting Brooklyn. It is a popular destination for food enthusiasts and trendy crowds seeking a unique, aesthetic dining experience, while also serving families and celebratory groups.

properties.description: Intimate omakase sushi restaurant offering a premium 18-course tasting menu with high-quality fish and authentic Japanese culinary craftsmanship.
properties.short_description: Intimate omakase sushi restaurant offering a premium 18-course tasting menu with high-quality fish and authentic Japanese culinary craftsmanship.
properties.cuisine_description: Ishi Omakase provides a premium, intimate dining experience centered on authentic Japanese culinary craftsmanship. The menu features an 18-course tasting experience that highlights high-quality fish sourced from Japan, including specialties like A5 Wagyu, uni, and fatty tuna. The preparation balances traditional techniques with creative, contemporary twists. Beverage offerings focus on a curated selection of sake and beer. The restaurant accommodates vegetarian and vegan dietary needs alongside its primary tasting menus.
properties.overall_description: This premium omakase destination offers an intimate, chef-led 18-course tasting experience that highlights both traditional Japanese craftsmanship and creative, modern flavor pairings. The menu showcases high-quality, fresh ingredients such as A5 Wagyu, uni, and fatty tuna, all served in an elegant and serene environment. With its focused, minimalist aesthetic and exceptional attention to service, it provides a sophisticated escape ideal for celebrations and discerning sushi lovers. The counter experience allows guests to engage directly with the chefs, making it a standout culinary addition to the neighborhood.
properties.service_description: Ishi Omakase offers an intimate counter-style dining experience through reservation-based seatings, as well as table service for a slightly different pace. The restaurant is well-regarded for attentive service and is a popular destination for milestone celebrations, including birthdays and anniversaries, often providing personalized touches for guests. They facilitate both dine-in at the sushi counter and table options, along with delivery and takeout services.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is refined, serene, and intimate, offering a calm sanctuary that emphasizes the focus on the dining experience. It strikes a balance between professional polish and warm, welcoming hospitality.
properties.amenities_description: The restaurant provides an elevated omakase experience featuring a dedicated chef's counter, attentive service, and a curated selection of premium sake and wine to pair with the multi-course meal.
properties.unique_selling_points: A high-end, chef-led 18-course tasting menu that combines traditional Japanese techniques with creative, modern flavor profiles. Every course is crafted with precision, featuring ingredients like A5 Wagyu, uni, and truffle.
properties.neighborhood_description: Situated in a vibrant, walkable neighborhood, the area is known for its blend of community charm, local shops, and emerging high-end dining destinations.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in a bustling commercial area, this restaurant features a simple, elegant exterior that opens into a clean, minimalist Japandi-inspired interior centered around an L-shaped sushi counter. The space is purposefully designed to focus attention on the craft of the sushi chefs.
properties.customer_demographics_description: The restaurant attracts a local customer base of food enthusiasts and sushi aficionados from the Park Slope area and beyond. It is a preferred destination for couples and small groups seeking an intimate, high-quality omakase experience for special occasions, as well as solo diners looking for an immersive counter meal.
